snippet.title: City Masterplan Official Reveal Trailer | 1:1 Scale UE5 City Builder
snippet.description:
Ever played a city builder and thought — just a little more? A bigger map, more realistic scale, traffic logic that actually makes sense…
We felt the same way. So we built our own.
City Masterplan — the first gameplay trailer is now live.
Built on Unreal Engine 5, City Masterplan is a realistic city-building simulation featuring true 1:1 scale architecture, photorealistic lighting, and a massive seamless map to bring your dream city to life. And yes — you'll still need to make sure your trucks aren't having an existential crisis on the highway, your residents don't riot over a missing park, and figure out why the factory is always one shipment short. City builder veterans, you know the trick 😉
🎮 Wishlist on Steam →  https://store.steampowered.com/app/4536610/CityMasterplan?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=Announcement
💬 Join the community & get Closed Beta access → https://discord.gg/jxBhKz29N5
